title: The Compton shift against scattering angle
caption: The wavelength increases by Δλ = λ_C(1 − cos θ) with λ_C = h/m_ec = 2.43 pm. It is zero for no deflection, 2.43 pm at 90° and a maximum of 2λ_C = 4.85 pm for backscatter, independent of the incident wavelength: X-rays of 70 pm scattered at 90° emerge at 72.4 pm.
alt: Graph of wavelength shift in picometres against scattering angle from 0 to 180 degrees: a rising curve from zero, 2.43 at 90 degrees and 4.85 at 180 degrees.
description: The horizontal axis is the photon's scattering angle θ in degrees; the vertical axis is the shift in wavelength Δλ in picometres.
The curve is Δλ = 2.43(1 − cos θ) pm: zero at 0°, 2.43 pm at 90° and 4.85 pm at 180°.
For the lesson's 70 pm X-rays at 90° the new wavelength is 70 + 2.43 = 72.4 pm.
